items.title: 18.10.1 Tezaabi manganate(VII) ions ka ethanedioate ions se reaction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the manganate(VII)-ethanedioate reaction (PDF 33).

blocks.text: Tezaabi manganate(VII) (permanganate) ions aur ethanedioate (oxalate) ions ke reaction ke liye kitab mein diye gaye do reduction half-reactions ka muqabla karein:

Zyada musbat E wala half-reaction reduction ki taraf chalta hai, is liye MnO4- reduce ho kar Mn2+ (oxidising agent) aur C2O4 2- oxidise ho kar CO2 (reducing agent) banta hai. Khoye gaye electrons hasil kiye gaye electrons ke barabar hone chahiye, is liye reduction half-equation ko 2 aur oxidation half-equation ko 5 se zarb diya jata hai:

items: Kitab ki qeematon se E cell = 1.52 - 0.49 = +1.03 V, is liye reaction mumkin hai.

blocks.title: Chhapi qeematein check karein
blocks.text: Kitab kul mua'adla 2MnO4- + 5C2O4 2- + 8H+ -> 5Mn2+ + 2CO2 + 8H2O chhaapti aur kehti hai ke oxidation half ko 2 se zarb diya; dono ghalatiyan hain, aur oopar ke balanced mua'adle mein 16H+, 2Mn2+ aur 10CO2 hain. Data tables CO2/ethanedioate jore ke liye aam taur par taqreeban -0.49 V (+0.49 V nahi) dete hain, jis se E cell taqreeban 1.52 - (-0.49) = +2.01 V banta. Dono tarah E cell musbat aur reaction mumkin hai.

blocks.prompt: MnO4- aur C2O4 2- ke reaction mein reducing agent kaun hai aur woh kis mein oxidise hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Ethanedioate ion, C2O4 2-; yeh carbon dioxide mein oxidise hota hai.

items: MnO4- (+1.52 V) reduce ho kar Mn2+; C2O4 2- oxidise ho kar CO2.
